items.source: The Java driver itself has a good overview of the supported types: The Cypher type system.
items.translation: Java 驱动程序本身对支持的类型提供了很好的概述：Cypher 类型系统。

items.source: The simple types we support plus all the simple types recognized by Spring.
items.translation: 我们支持的简单类型加上 Spring 识别的所有简单类型。

items.source:
The simple types we support plus all the simple types recognized by Spring. Not
taking custom conversions into account.
items.translation: 我们支持的基本类型加上 Spring 识别的所有基本类型。此处不考虑自定义转换。

items.source: A list of Neo4j simple types: All attributes that can be mapped to a property. Some special logic has to be applied for domain attributes of the collection types List and Map. Those can be mapped to simple properties as well as to relationships to other things.
items.translation: Neo4j 简单类型列表：所有可映射为属性的属性。对于集合类型的域属性，需要应用一些特殊逻辑，例如 List 和 Map。这些集合既可以映射为简单属性，也可以映射为与其他实体的关系。
